The '''R-Crate Coil''' was a model of [[Sleight box/Legends|sleight box]] manufactured by [[Ecls Industries]]. Custom-made, they cost between seven hundred and fifty to two thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] a piece.<ref name="PSG" />
